text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(—I've got this! None stand before me 
now!!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan
text_block_list.text:
OGUUUUURIII!! Don't lose! Give it 
everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(...I can feel it...! What incredible 
momentum!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh... OOOOOOOOH!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap! It's Oguri Cap!! Oguri Cap 
crosses the finish line in first place!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I fell short, huh...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(I never expected Oguri-san to surge 
forward like that in the final stretch...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(During the race, I didn't feel much of 
that scorching, overwhelming pressure from 
Oguri-san.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Composed, yet with a razor-sharp 
stride... Just like the flow of pure, 
clear water.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Her running style is completely different 
from mine.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I cannot let it end with a defeat. One 
day, we shall have a rematch...!

Upon returning to the waiting room, Yaeno 
Muteki was her usual self, showing no 
signs of feeling down.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No... I am deeply ashamed.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, being able to run today without 
wearing myself out was a worthwhile 
takeaway.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Far more steadily than in her debut race, 
she managed to achieve the union of fire 
and water.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: With this, even the Satsuki Sho...!

Yaeno Muteki shows a flash of confidence. 
It seems she's feeling good about the 
upcoming Satsuki Sho!

And soon after, the days of training for 
the Satsuki Sho began.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a coincidence. Are you out for 
roadwork too, Yaeno-san?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes, to serve as a warm-up as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Where do you usually run, Yaeno-san?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I usually go to the course up by the 
hill, but...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Riverbanks, mostly, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see~. So if we take the riverbed 
course... wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's Ardan-san getting out of the taxi. 
I wonder if she went somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan-san, were you out?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, I had gone to the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Are you feeling unwell...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just a regular clinic visit. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I have decided to forgo running in the 
Satsuki Sho."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The toll from the debut race was heavier 
than expected... and it sounds like her 
recovery will take some time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Entering the Satsuki Sho in top form will 
be difficult. In that case, I will wager 
everything on my greatest goal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
To achieve a radiant crown just like my 
elder sister, who etched her name into 
magnificent history, I too shall—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, the "Japanese Derby." I shall 
go forth to claim the pinnacle of Classic 
glory.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: For the Japan Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Spending ample time and ensuring 
rock-solid conditioning, I will take on 
the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Though my body may be as fragile as glass, 
I have not the slightest intention of 
yielding. From this moment on, everything 
is for the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to watching both of your 
performances closely at the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Indeed, please feast your eyes upon this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. If you'll excuse me, then.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Even if Ardan-san will not be running, 
what I must do remains unchanged."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Win the Satsuki Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wah, I won't give up either!! I'm not 
losing to Yaeno-san!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san, let us meet on the track at 
the Satsuki Sho.
